{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
set -eo pipefail
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
cd /root/structfuse

# ============================================================================
# StarCoder M2 chain resume — remaining 4 runs
# embedding_distance_s44, dataflow_aware_s42, dataflow_aware_s43, dataflow_aware_s44
# ============================================================================

GPU_ID="${1:-1}"
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="$GPU_ID"
export WANDB_MODE=offline
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True

MODEL_PATH="/root/autodl-tmp/models/bigcode/starcoder2-3b/bigcode/starcoder2-3b"
DATA_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/full_m2_starcoder_data"
OUTPUT_BASE="/root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/checkpoints/m2_full_starcoder"
TRAIN_SCRIPT="/root/structfuse/training/train.py"

echo "============================================"
echo " StarCoder M2 Chain Resume"
echo " GPU: $GPU_ID"
echo " Start: $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
echo " Runs: embed_s44, dataflow_s42, dataflow_s43, dataflow_s44"
echo "============================================"

run_training() {
    local strategy="$1"
    local seed="$2"
    local epochs="$3"
    local patience="$4"
    local tag="${strategy}_s${seed}"
    local output_dir="${OUTPUT_BASE}/${tag}"
    local train_file="${DATA_DIR}/train_${strategy}_s${seed}.jsonl"
    local val_file="${DATA_DIR}/val_${strategy}_s${seed}.jsonl"

    echo ""
    echo "=========================================="
    echo " [$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] START: ${tag}"
    echo " epochs=${epochs}, patience=${patience}"
    echo " output: ${output_dir}"
    echo "=========================================="

    if [ ! -f "$train_file" ]; then
        echo "ERROR: train file not found: $train_file"
        return 1
    fi
    if [ ! -f "$val_file" ]; then
        echo "ERROR: val file not found: $val_file"
        return 1
    fi

    mkdir -p "$output_dir"

    local cmd=(
        python -u "$TRAIN_SCRIPT"
        --model-name "$MODEL_PATH"
        --train-file "$train_file"
        --val-file "$val_file"
        --output-dir "$output_dir"
        --hard-negative-strategy "$strategy"
        --seed "$seed"
        --batch-size 8
        --num-negatives 7
        --max-seq-length 2048
        --num-epochs "$epochs"
        --learning-rate 2e-5
        --temperature 0.07
        --hard-negative-ratio 0.5
        --eval-steps 500
        --save-steps 1000
        --use-lora
        --gradient-checkpointing
        --wandb-project structfuse
        --wandb-run-name "m2_full_sc2_${tag}"
    )

    if [ "$patience" -gt 0 ]; then
        cmd+=(--early-stopping-patience "$patience")
    fi

    if [ "$strategy" = "dataflow_aware" ]; then
        cmd+=(--dataflow-graph-file "${DATA_DIR}/dataflow_graph.json")
    fi

    "${cmd[@]}" 2>&1 || {
        local ec=$?
        echo "WARNING: ${tag} exited with code $ec"
        if [ ! -d "${output_dir}/best_by_val_loss" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: no checkpoint produced for ${tag}, aborting chain"
            exit 1
        fi
        echo "Checkpoint exists despite non-zero exit, continuing..."
    }

    echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] DONE: ${tag}"
    if [ -d "${output_dir}/best_by_val_loss" ]; then
        echo "  ✓ best_by_val_loss checkpoint saved"
    fi
    if [ -d "${output_dir}/best_by_recall_at_1" ]; then
        echo "  ✓ best_by_recall_at_1 checkpoint saved"
    fi

    # Clean intermediate checkpoints
    find "$output_dir" -maxdepth 1 -name "checkpoint-*" -type d -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
    echo ""
}

# ── Run 1: embedding_distance s44 (2 epochs, patience=2) ──
run_training "embedding_distance" 44 2 2

# ── Run 2: dataflow_aware s42 (3 epochs, no early stopping) ──
run_training "dataflow_aware" 42 3 0

# ── Run 3: dataflow_aware s43 (2 epochs, patience=2) ──
run_training "dataflow_aware" 43 2 2

# ── Run 4: dataflow_aware s44 (2 epochs, patience=2) ──
run_training "dataflow_aware" 44 2 2

echo "============================================"
echo " ALL 4 REMAINING RUNS COMPLETED"
echo " End: $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
echo "============================================"
